options.name: auto_import_keys
options.description: Automatically import the gpg signing key of the new or changed repository. Has an effect only if O(state=present). Has no effect on existing (unchanged) repositories or in combination with O(state=absent). Implies O(runrefresh). Only works with C(.repo) files if O(name) is given explicitly.

options.name: autorefresh
options.description: Enable autorefresh of the repository. When not specified, the value from the C(.repo) file is used if available, otherwise it defaults to V(true).

options.name: disable_gpg_check
options.description: Whether to disable GPG signature checking of all packages. Has an effect only if O(state=present). Needs C(zypper) version >= 1.6.2. When not specified, the value from the C(.repo) file is used if available, otherwise it defaults to V(false).

options.name: enabled
options.description: Set repository to enabled (or disabled). When not specified, the value from the C(.repo) file is used if available, otherwise it defaults to V(true).

options.name: name
options.description: A name for the repository. Not required when adding repofiles.

options.name: overwrite_multiple
options.description: Overwrite multiple repository entries, if repositories with both name and URL already exist.

options.name: priority
options.description: Set priority of repository. Packages are always installed from the repository with the smallest priority number. Needs C(zypper) version >= 1.12.25.

options.name: repo
options.description: URI of the repository or full path of a C(.repo) file. Required when O(state=present).

options.name: runrefresh
options.description: Refresh the package list of the given repository. Can be used with O(repo=*) to refresh all repositories.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the repository should exist or not. A source string state.
